title: Understanding Logistic Regression
text: Logistic regression is used to predict the probability of a binary outcome. The model uses a logistic function to map predicted values to probabilities. The formula for the logistic function is $$\frac{1}{1+e^{\left(-z\right)}}$$, where $$z$$ is the linear combination of the input features and the model parameters.

title: Calculate the Linear Combination
text: To find the probability, first calculate the linear combination $$z$$ using the formula $$z=\theta_0+\theta_1 x_1+\theta_2 x_2$$. Use the given parameters and the new data point $$x_{new}=(1,4)$$.
